title: 高速鐵路受流性能驗證~Current-collection verification for high-speed rail
focus: 接觸力離線受流率與測試不確定度~Contact force contact loss and test uncertainty
summary: 高速鐵路受流性能驗證以「接觸力離線受流率與測試不確定度」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。受電弓與電車線耦合時，平均接觸力、力的散布、離線與電弧必須分開量測，單一平均值無法描述短暫中斷。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops contact force contact loss and test uncertainty through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Coupled pantograph and contact-line behavior requires separate measures of mean force, dispersion, loss of contact and arcing; a mean cannot describe brief interruptions. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把高速鐵路受流性能驗證放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。受電弓與電車線耦合時，平均接觸力、力的散布、離線與電弧必須分開量測，單一平均值無法描述短暫中斷。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Current-collection verification for high-speed rail in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Coupled pantograph and contact-line behavior requires separate measures of mean force, dispersion, loss of contact and arcing; a mean cannot describe brief interruptions. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N；y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N。只把 F1 增加百分之十，y=113 N。模型邊界：等時距三筆合成取樣；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=80 N, F2=100 N, F3=120 N；y=sqrt((F1**2+F2**2+F3**2)/3)=101.325 N。只把 F1 增加百分之十，y=103.512 N。模型邊界：等權有限樣本均方根；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N; y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N. Increasing only F1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=113 N. Boundary: Three equally spaced synthetic samples; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=80 N, F2=100 N, F3=120 N; y=sqrt((F1**2+F2**2+F3**2)/3)=101.325 N. Increasing only F1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=103.512 N. Boundary: Equal-weight finite-sample RMS; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.title: 平均接觸力~Mean contact force
units.mechanism: 平均力描述時窗中央趨勢而不保證持續接觸。本模型把 F1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 113 N。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。等時距三筆合成取樣。使用最小力與接觸影像作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；正常平均可同時含零接觸片段，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Mean force describes the central tendency of a window without guaranteeing continuous contact. In this model, F1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 113 N. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Three equally spaced synthetic samples. Use minimum force and contact images as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A normal mean can include zero-contact intervals; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N；y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N。只把 F1 增加百分之十，y=113 N。模型邊界：等時距三筆合成取樣；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N; y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N. Increasing only F1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=113 N. Boundary: Three equally spaced synthetic samples; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以最小力與接觸影像區分模型與觀察，先用低載力計與同步攝影建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「平均接觸力」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use minimum force and contact images to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-load force gauge and synchronized video, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Mean contact force. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 正常平均可同時含零接觸片段。這個失效與「平均接觸力」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查最小力與接觸影像，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~A normal mean can include zero-contact intervals. This failure and a measurement bias in Mean contact force can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check minimum force and contact images rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：正常平均可同時含零接觸片段~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A normal mean can include zero-contact intervals.
units.practice: 重算「平均接觸力」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出等時距三筆合成取樣如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由正常平均可同時含零接觸片段造成偏離的合成觀察，以最小力與接觸影像說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Mean contact force, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Three equally spaced synthetic samples. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: A normal mean can include zero-contact intervals. Explain which evidence in minimum force and contact images distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.title: 接觸力均方根~Contact-force RMS
units.mechanism: 均方根與算術平均反映不同的力統計。本模型把 F1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 103.512 N。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。等權有限樣本均方根。使用完整力時序與均值作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；少數尖峰可提高均方根卻被平均掩蓋，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~RMS and arithmetic mean describe different force statistics. In this model, F1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 103.512 N. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Equal-weight finite-sample RMS. Use complete force time history and mean as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A few peaks raise RMS while a mean hides them; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=80 N, F2=100 N, F3=120 N；y=sqrt((F1**2+F2**2+F3**2)/3)=101.325 N。只把 F1 增加百分之十，y=103.512 N。模型邊界：等權有限樣本均方根；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=80 N, F2=100 N, F3=120 N; y=sqrt((F1**2+F2**2+F3**2)/3)=101.325 N. Increasing only F1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=103.512 N. Boundary: Equal-weight finite-sample RMS; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以完整力時序與均值區分模型與觀察，先用離線力資料與校正表建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「接觸力均方根」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use complete force time history and mean to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using offline force data and calibration sheet, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Contact-force RMS. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 少數尖峰可提高均方根卻被平均掩蓋。這個失效與「接觸力均方根」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查完整力時序與均值，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~A few peaks raise RMS while a mean hides them. This failure and a measurement bias in Contact-force RMS can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check complete force time history and mean rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：少數尖峰可提高均方根卻被平均掩蓋~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A few peaks raise RMS while a mean hides them.
units.practice: 重算「接觸力均方根」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出等權有限樣本均方根如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由少數尖峰可提高均方根卻被平均掩蓋造成偏離的合成觀察，以完整力時序與均值說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Contact-force RMS, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Equal-weight finite-sample RMS. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: A few peaks raise RMS while a mean hides them. units.anchor: 力散布標準差~Contact-force population deviation
units.title: 力散布標準差~Contact-force population deviation
units.mechanism: 全體樣本標準差量化此時窗相對均值的散布。本模型把 F1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 13.1993 N。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。三個等權樣本的全體標準差，式內平均隨擾動重算。使用時窗分段後散布作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；混合不同速度時窗會把工況差當隨機散布，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Population deviation quantifies spread about the mean in this window. In this model, F1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 13.1993 N. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Population deviation of three equally weighted samples, with the mean recalculated inside the expression. Use spread in segmented windows as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Mixing speed regimes confuses operating changes with random spread; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=80 N, F2=100 N, F3=120 N；y=sqrt(((F1-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2+(F2-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2+(F3-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2)/3)=16.3299 N。只把 F1 增加百分之十，y=13.1993 N。模型邊界：三個等權樣本的全體標準差，式內平均隨擾動重算；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=80 N, F2=100 N, F3=120 N; y=sqrt(((F1-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2+(F2-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2+(F3-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2)/3)=16.3299 N. Increasing only F1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=13.1993 N. Boundary: Population deviation of three equally weighted samples, with the mean recalculated inside the expression; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以時窗分段後散布區分模型與觀察，先用合成時序分段統計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「力散布標準差」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use spread in segmented windows to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. units.failure: 混合不同速度時窗會把工況差當隨機散布。這個失效與「力散布標準差」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查時窗分段後散布，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Mixing speed regimes confuses operating changes with random spread. units.anchor: 離線時間比例~Loss-of-contact duration fraction
units.title: 離線時間比例~Loss-of-contact duration fraction
units.mechanism: 持續時間比與離線事件數是不同指標。本模型把 lost 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.44 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。固定辨識門檻的合成時窗。使用離線起迄時間與事件數作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；相同事件數可能有完全不同中斷時間，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Duration fraction and number of contact-loss events are different metrics. In this model, lost is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.44 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Synthetic window with a fixed detection definition. Use contact-loss start/end times and event count as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Equal event counts can conceal very different interruption durations; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：lost=0.08 s, total=20 s；y=lost/total*100=0.4 percent。只把 lost 增加百分之十，y=0.44 percent。模型邊界：固定辨識門檻的合成時窗；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: lost=0.08 s, total=20 s; y=lost/total*100=0.4 percent. units.anchor: 電弧事件時間~Arc-event exposure fraction
units.title: 電弧事件時間~Arc-event exposure fraction
units.mechanism: 電弧時間需定義偵測頻寬與事件合併規則。本模型把 arc 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.044 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。僅用既有合成事件，不產生真實電弧。使用光學事件與電流同步作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；外界閃光可能造成假電弧事件，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Arc duration requires defined sensing bandwidth and event-merging rules. In this model, arc is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.044 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Use synthetic recorded events only, without creating real arcs. Use optical events synchronized with current as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. External flashes may create false arc detections; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：arc=12 ms, test=30 s；y=arc/(test*1000)*100=0.04 percent。只把 arc 增加百分之十，y=0.044 percent。模型邊界：僅用既有合成事件，不產生真實電弧；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: arc=12 ms, test=30 s; y=arc/(test*1000)*100=0.04 percent. Increasing only arc with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.044 percent. Boundary: Use synthetic recorded events only, without creating real arcs; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以光學事件與電流同步區分模型與觀察，先用合成光電訊號與時間戳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「電弧事件時間」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use optical events synchronized with current to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic optical/electrical signals and timestamps, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Arc-event exposure fraction. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 外界閃光可能造成假電弧事件。這個失效與「電弧事件時間」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查光學事件與電流同步，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~External flashes may create false arc detections. units.anchor: 接觸點抬升量~Contact-point uplift scale
units.title: 接觸點抬升量~Contact-point uplift scale
units.mechanism: 線性等效剛度把接觸力連到局部抬升。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 9.16667 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。指定接觸位置的靜態等效剛度。使用接觸點與支點位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把跨中剛度套到吊點會錯估抬升，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Linear equivalent stiffness links contact force to local uplift. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 9.16667 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Static equivalent stiffness at a specified contact position. Use contact and support displacements as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Using midspan stiffness at a dropper misestimates uplift; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

units.title: 測試訊號取樣~Test-signal sample interval

units.anchor: 合成量測不確定度~Combined force uncertainty
units.title: 合成量測不確定度~Combined force uncertainty
units.mechanism: 獨立標準不確定度可平方和合成，相關項須加共變異。本模型把 sensor 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 3.85227 N。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。零共變異的一階近似。使用各項校正與相關性作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把共同偏差當獨立會低估力不確定度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Independent standard uncertainties combine by root-sum-square; correlated terms require covariance. In this model, sensor is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 3.85227 N. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. First-order approximation with zero covariance. Use calibration and correlation of each contribution as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Treating shared bias as independent understates uncertainty; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：sensor=2 N, inertia=3 N, sync=1 N；y=sqrt(sensor**2+inertia**2+sync**2)=3.74166 N。只把 sensor 增加百分之十，y=3.85227 N。模型邊界：零共變異的一階近似；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: sensor=2 N, inertia=3 N, sync=1 N; y=sqrt(sensor**2+inertia**2+sync**2)=3.74166 N. Increasing only sensor with a ten-percent increase gives y=3.85227 N. Boundary: First-order approximation with zero covariance; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以各項校正與相關性區分模型與觀察，先用校正證據與重複測試建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「合成量測不確定度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use calibration and correlation of each contribution to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using calibration evidence and repeat tests, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Combined force uncertainty. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 把共同偏差當獨立會低估力不確定度。這個失效與「合成量測不確定度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查各項校正與相關性，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Treating shared bias as independent understates uncertainty. This failure and a measurement bias in Combined force uncertainty can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check calibration and correlation of each contribution rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把共同偏差當獨立會低估力不確定度~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating shared bias as independent understates uncertainty.
units.practice: 重算「合成量測不確定度」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出零共變異的一階近似如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把共同偏差當獨立會低估力不確定度造成偏離的合成觀察，以各項校正與相關性說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Combined force uncertainty, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: First-order approximation with zero covariance. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Treating shared bias as independent understates uncertainty. Explain which evidence in calibration and correlation of each contribution distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
